test_title: RRB NTPC CBT 2 (Level-5) Official Paper (Held On: 15 June 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Which of the following statements is TRUE about mixed economy?

options.text: A mixed economy is one in which the public sector (consisting of government enterprises) and the private sector (consisting of private enterprises) coexist with each other
A mixed economy is one in which only the public sector exists.
A mixed economy is one in which the public sector (consisting of government enterprises) and the private sector (consisting of private enterprises) do not coexist with each other.
A mixed economy is one in which only the private sector (consisting of private enterprises) exists.

solution:
The correct answer is __**A mixed economy is one in which the public sector (consisting of government enterprises) and the private sector (consisting of private enterprises) coexist with each other.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **A market system of resource allocation, commerce, and trade in which free markets coexist with government intervention**.
 
• **M****ixed economies** have public, private, legislative, judicial, and regulatory components.
 
• The main feature of a mixed economy is the **co-existence of both public and private enterprises**.
 
• They work together. The industries in the private sector are managed and operated completely by private entrepreneurs.
 
• It allows the free market and the laws of supply and demand to determine prices. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• An **economy** is a system whereby goods are produced and exchanged. Without a viable economy, a state will collapse. 
 
• There are three main types of Economy:
 
 
• **​Free market.**
 
• **Command**
 
• **Mixed economy**.
 
 
 
• ​**Capitalism** is the greatest economic system because it has numerous benefits and creates multiple opportunities for individuals in society. 
 
• Some of these benefits include producing wealth and innovation, improving the lives of individuals, and giving power to the people.
